description: fmri-skill 统筹已登记的独立方法和可复用流程。支持：ROI 时间序列与功能连接；任务态一级 GLM；组水平 GLM；FSL 运动校正；FSL 层间时间校正；按用户文件映射整理 BIDS（文件名检查）；fMRIPrep 本地环境执行；FSL FLIRT；其他方法可在详情中分页查询。

method_refs.label: ROI 时间序列与功能连接
method_refs.role: Extract standardized, detrended ROI time series with Nilearn NiftiLabelsMasker and calculate a correlation connectivity matrix with ConnectivityMeasure; export ROI time series and NPY/CSV matrices。 Inputs: bold: 预处理 BOLD 影像 (file); atlas: 分区图谱 (file); labels: 图谱标签 (file). Registered outputs: results/connectome.npy, results/roi_timeseries.csv.

method_refs.label: 任务态一级 GLM
method_refs.role: Reference Nilearn snippet for first-level task GLM。 Inputs: bold: 预处理 BOLD 影像 (file); events: 事件表 (file); confounds: 混杂变量 (file); mask: 脑掩膜 (file). Registered outputs: results/z_map.nii.gz, results/effect_map.nii.gz.

method_refs.label: 组水平 GLM
method_refs.role: Reference Nilearn snippet for second-level GLM。 Inputs: contrast_maps: 对比影像路径清单 (file); design_matrix: 组设计矩阵 (file); mask: 脑掩膜 (file). Registered outputs: results/second_level_z_map.nii.gz.

method_refs.label: FSL 运动校正
method_refs.role: Correct motion in a 4D image series with FSL MCFLIRT and save the corrected series, motion plots and transformation matrices。 Inputs: input: 输入影像 (file). Registered outputs: results/image.nii.gz. Fixed invocation options: --operation mcflirt.

method_refs.label: FSL 层间时间校正
method_refs.role: Correct slice acquisition timing in a 4D series with FSL slicetimer using the supplied repetition time, slice axis and acquisition order。 Inputs: input: 输入影像 (file). Registered outputs: results/image.nii.gz. Fixed invocation options: --operation slicetimer.

method_refs.label: 按用户文件映射整理 BIDS（文件名检查）

execution_resolution.reason: 支持显式文件映射整理；完整数据集验证仍需 BIDS Validator CLI，不把文件名检查当作完整验证。

method_refs.role: Copy files according to an explicit source-relative to BIDS-relative JSON mapping, check destination filenames with BIDSValidator, and write dataset metadata and a staging report. It does not infer missing entities or perform full dataset validation。 Inputs: input: 源数据集目录 (directory); mapping: 显式文件映射 JSON（源相对路径 → BIDS 相对路径） (file). Registered outputs: results/dataset_description.json, results/staging_report.json. Fixed invocation options: --operation stage.

selection_rules: 先确认目标产物、允许使用的已有输入与禁止复用的结果；仅在用户允许时复用已有数据，不默认追加上游步骤。
独立操作选择 Method；确需固定组合时选择 Pipeline，并检查每一步输入输出。
软件工具 Skill 用于选择实现，任务 Skill 用于组织需求，不因为同时匹配两类 Skill 重复添加方法。

Treat missing inputs according to the current goal: for explicitly requested steps, ask for binding or discuss alternatives; when asked to produce a target from stated inputs, add only necessary available producers allowed by the user. Never regenerate an explicitly reused result or silently broaden the scientific goal.

Select by scientific output meaning, stage conditions and spatial/data requirements. A directory, generic image or report does not certify a typed derivative. Do not equate tissue classes, anatomical atlas regions and learned clusters. Query the Method contract for exact ports and conditional parameters; use Pipelines only when their actual steps match the request.
name: fmri-skill
applicability: 根据目标选择对应 Method 或 Pipeline；每个入口的输入格式、必要参数和产物以其独立契约为准。
limitations: 格式和样本数量满足仅是必要条件；空间、单位、样本标识与方法假设仍须按所选方法检查。
这里只统筹已登记入口；目录收录不代表覆盖软件全部命令或参数。
环境探测与运行证据分别显示；合成数据测试不代表真实数据的科学有效性。
尚无 Method 的规划能力只能提供说明，不能当作可执行步骤。
